title: Almond ricotta pancakes with cinnamon apples

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Apples, butter, honey, ricotta, eggs, ground almonds and Greek yoghurt are all plain whole foods a grandparent could have kept.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is a standard Tesco line, and 100g of ground almonds and a tub of ricotta are everyday purchases rather than treats.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a small pan, a frying pan, a bowl and a whisk, and frying spoonfuls of batter is within a confident beginner's reach.

works.reason: The batter of 4 eggs to 250g ricotta and only 100g ground almonds, with no flour, will be loose rather than the 'thick batter' promised, so the pancakes are likely to tear when turned; the frying heat is also not given.

honest_times.reason: Slicing the apples, frying them and frying the pancakes in batches comes to roughly the 25 active minutes printed, with the apples cooking while the batter is whisked.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used in the steps, nothing unlisted appears, and 'eating apples' matches the apples id.

seasonal_feel.reason: Warm, buttery cinnamon apples from store suit a cold February morning, and three apples make them a real topping rather than a garnish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short and clear, in plain British English, with no restaurant language or preaching.

hearty_healthy.reason: Eggs, ricotta, almonds, yoghurt and fruit make a filling, protein-rich breakfast with little sugar that a family would happily eat again.
